b475fd5b-f80e-4399-b2e4-e2d1e4155495.title: Rust excursion: evaluate full-PSP Rust port once LibAFL 11.x lands
b475fd5b-f80e-4399-b2e4-e2d1e4155495.description: Workspace .workspace/rust-excursion, builddir build-rust: Rust-ON QEMU 10.2 links (recipe in scratch/HANDOFF-qemu-psp.md). ce655d9e-6244-4ec9-9e00-0ad2ffd88e47.author: U0Ke
ce655d9e-6244-4ec9-9e00-0ad2ffd88e47.content: Rust-ON build recipe: PATH += /nix/store/*-rustc-1.98.1/bin, *-cargo-1.98.1/bin, *-rust-bindgen-unwrapped-0.72.1/bin; BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS='-isystem /nix/store/*-glibc-2.44-25-dev/include'; ../configure --target-list=arm-softmmu --without-default-features --enable-fdt=internal --audio-drv-list= --enable-nettle --enable-rust --disable-werror; workspace .workspace/rust-excursion, builddir build-rust. Plan: stacked PRs IC, CCP, timer, mailbox doorbell, Zen3 bring-up, JSON reg tables, then Rust port after LibAFL 11.x.

bbea8178-d6fa-4271-80ec-68db95ee9157.title: PR 6 (stack tip): JSON register tables — finish round-2 review fixes, verify, split into 2 commits
bbea8178-d6fa-4271-80ec-68db95ee9157.description: Local bookmark claude/psp-regs-wip (unreviewed WIP). Round-2 fixes requested from the Haiku subagent: dup-key rejection, normalised+sorted JSON enforced, psp-regs.c.inc static include, validations, dead-code removal, generator unit tests. NEXT: check working copy state, rebuild (cd build-nix && ninja qemu-system-arm), rerun Zen3 trace-equivalence vs 6e3dfe27 (see scratch/HANDOFF-qemu-psp.md), run test_gen_regs.py, re-run the-hater then the-verifier, then split: commit A pure conversion (the 4 Zen3 entries still in generic.json), commit B move them to zen3.json with a message stating other generations now read 0 there. Findings in scratch/HATER-regs.md.

22f1b739-fa6e-4af0-802f-f57932889c3b.author: U0Ke
22f1b739-fa6e-4af0-802f-f57932889c3b.content: Trace-equivalence check (Zen3): flash16.bin = tail -c 16777216 of psp-etl :8830 /roms/814b2392...916f.rom; run qemu-system-arm -machine amd-psp-zen3 -nographic -display none -serial null -monitor none -device loader,file=scratch/fw/onchip.bin,addr=0xffff0000,force-raw=on -global driver=amd_psp.smnflash,property=flash_img,value=flash16.bin -bios flash16.bin -d trace:psp_* -D log (25 s); compare sed -E 's/0x[0-9a-f]+/N/g'|sort|uniq -c vs 6e3dfe27 baseline. 2026-10-19: 0a787d01 identical (5704 lines, ends sts 0x107). Open: round-2 review fixes (dup-key rejection, generator tests); scratch/HATER-regs.md has review.
